evidence.text: Legacy bound targets: proven dispatch sites plus C++ vtable-prefix bounds from typeinf.nominal --structure-only --observe. They assume the closed vtable census and compatible overrides documented in recomp-kit/docs/type-inference.md; per-row proof classification was not retained.
_callnewh reads _pnhHeap (0091fa9c), the only reference to it: _set_new_handler is not linked, so the pointer stays null and this call never runs.

The COM sites call d3d8, DSOUND and DINPUT8 interfaces, which only those DLLs implement; each was observed reaching one method whose vtable slot matches the call displacement. CreateDevice resets PC/RC unless D3DCREATE_FPU_PRESERVE.

D3D8 CreateDevice changes PC/RC unless D3DCREATE_FPU_PRESERVE; early returns precede the control-word update, so only the fixed bits are asserted

dx/d3d8.cpp handlers and D3D8-specific COM lifetime hooks do not invoke guest callbacks; com_ret writes guest EAX, imports_dispatch adjusts ESP, and other GPRs and arithmetic flags retain their guest values. Reads remain conservative.
dx/d3d8_fpu.h contains the only D3D8 guest CW update; CreateDevice has its own effect. Unsupported methods terminate with named diagnostics.
